spans.s:
√rah (rahitá; ráhitum). leave, give up,
abandon.
+ vi, abandon, separate from, in viraha.

rahas, n. solitude; lonely place; as adv.
[1111b], secretly. [√rah.]

rāhú, m. The Seizer, Rāhu, who is supposed
to seize and swallow sun and moon,
and thus cause eclipses. [prob. fr. √rabh,
1178^2.]
